Question: A six-pole dynamo, with interpoles, requires 360 inductors on its armature, with three turns per coil and two coil sides per slot. (a) Determine the number of coils, slots, and commutator bars. (b) Select suitable pitches for a simplex lap winding.

Options: 
A. Coils = Bars = Slots = 180, Front pitch = 8 slots for progressive and 10 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 3 bars
B. Coils = Bars = Slots = 72, Front pitch = 9 slots for progressive and 10 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 2 bars
C. Coils = Bars = Slots = 90, Front pitch = 11 slots for progressive and 13 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 2 bars
D. Coils = Bars = Slots = 80, Front pitch = 12 slots for progressive and 14 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 2 bars
E. Coils = Bars = Slots = 120, Front pitch = 7 slots for progressive and 9 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 1 bar
F. Coils = Bars = Slots = 30, Front pitch = 8 slots for progressive and 10 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 1 bar
G. Coils = Bars = Slots = 45, Front pitch = 10 slots for progressive and 12 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 1 bar
H. Coils = Bars = Slots = 120, Front pitch = 10 slots for progressive and 12 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 2 bars
I. Coils = Bars = Slots = 60, Front pitch = 9 slots for progressive and 11 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 1 bar
J. Coils = Bars = Slots = 100, Front pitch = 11 slots for progressive and 13 slots for retrogressive winding, Commutator pitch = 2 bars

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
